units.source_text: 有时候，父亲又非常凄凉地对我说：“我要是死了，你可要多孝敬你妈啊。”

en.t: Sometimes Father would say to me again, in a terribly forlorn voice, "If I die, you must be especially good to your mother."

units.source_text: 我对“我要是死了”这句话记忆犹新，就是我毕业的那天晚上，也就是快要离开东京的时候，先生对夫人重复了好几遍的那句话。

en.t: The phrase "If I die" remained vivid in my memory; it was the very phrase Sensei had repeated several times to his wife on the night of my graduation, when I was about to leave Tokyo.

units.source_text: 我回想起了笑着这么说的先生和捂着耳朵不愿听这晦气话的夫人，

en.t: I recalled Sensei saying it with a smile, and his wife covering her ears because she did not want to hear such an ill-omened thing,

units.source_text: 那时先生说的“我要是死了”只是单纯的假设，而现在父亲说的，却是随时可能发生的事实。

en.t: At that time Sensei's "If I die" had been only a simple supposition, but what Father was saying now was a fact that might happen at any moment.

units.source_text: 我模仿不了夫人对先生的那种神态，但是，也不能不说些好听的话来安慰父亲。

en.t: I could not imitate the way Sensei's wife had responded to him, but I also could not help saying something pleasant to comfort Father.

units.source_text: “你千万不要说这样气馁的话，你不是说病好了以后还要去东京一次吗？

en.t: "You must not say such dispirited things. Didn't you say that once you got better, you wanted to go to Tokyo once more?
This time, go together with Mother.

units.source_text: 到时候，你一定会大吃一惊的，东京变化可大了，光是电车路线就新开通了好几条。

en.t: When you do, you will certainly be astonished; Tokyo has changed enormously, and even the streetcar lines alone have added several new routes.

units.source_text: 电车一通，街道就会发生变化，加上市政也在进行改造。

en.t: Once the streetcars start running, the streets change, and on top of that the city is carrying out municipal improvements.

units.source_text: 总之一句话，东京可以说是一天二十四小时都在变，没有一刻消停的。”

en.t: In short, you could say Tokyo is changing twenty-four hours a day, without a single moment's rest."

units.source_text: 出于无奈，我不住嘴地说了好多可说可不说的话，父亲似乎还挺爱听。

en.t: Having no other choice, I kept talking and said many things that hardly needed saying, and Father seemed quite pleased to listen.
